settings.heading: How does it work?
settings.content:
Our proprietary blend was specifically formulated to give you thicker, fuller, stronger hair. Get ready to love your hair again. 

Decrease Shedding 

Acetyl tetrapeptide-3 is a peptide which has a direct effect on the hair follicle and its vitality. The peptide signals tissue remodeling of the hair follicle to grow, which helps anchor the follicle in your scalp so that it’s stronger.

Blocks DHT

Biochanin A, extracted from Red Clover (Trifolium pretense), is a powerful flavonoid. It is an effective inhibitor of 5-α-reductase (type I & II) activity, DHT Modulation. Reducing the hair follicle miniaturization process. 

Anti-Aging & Scalp Health

Our apple cell stem culture blend (High in antioxidants) is a unique and revolutionary ingredient able to protect the most precious hair cells—the hair stem cells—against premature aging and loss.

No More Breakage

Caffeine and Niacinamide coat the hair, helping it appear instantly thicker, and remain protected from breakage.

settings.title: Reduce DHT in the scalp with topical finasteride
settings.subtitle: Recent clinical studies suggest that topical finasteride treatment can help prevent further hair loss in men with androgenetic alopecia (aka male pattern hair loss), while having a lower side effect profile than when taken as a pill. Finasteride works by blocking an enzyme that converts testosterone into DHT, a hormone that can weaken hair follicles.
